# Privacy Policy: Recent Reviews for Google Search & Maps

Last updated: November 2026

**Recent Reviews for Google Search & Maps** ("the extension") does not collect, store off your device, share, or sell any personal data.

## What the extension reads
When you view a place on Google Search or Google Maps, the extension reads the place's rating and the reviews shown on that page (their stars and dates) to calculate the average of recent reviews. This happens entirely in your browser. Nothing it reads is sent anywhere.

## What the extension stores
The extension saves your settings using Chrome's extension storage (`chrome.storage.sync`): whether the badge is on for Google Search and for Google Maps, the longest time window shown, and the window the reviews list opens on. If you are signed in to Chrome with sync enabled, Chrome may sync these settings between your own devices. The extension does not store reviews or anything about the places you look at.

## What the extension does not do
- It has no server and makes no network requests of its own.
- It has no analytics, tracking, advertising or accounts.
- It does not load or run remote code.
- It only runs on Google Search and Google Maps pages.

## Not affiliated with Google
This extension is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google. Google, Google Search and Google Maps are trademarks of Google LLC.
